cues: Chlorobenzene can be made directly from benzene and chlorine, in the dark, with a Lewis acid halogen carrier such as anhydrous aluminium chloride, iron three chloride, or iron filings.
The catalyst creates the real attacker, a chlorine cation, which substitutes on the ring.
